purpose: Technical validation only; no target-answer scoring or configuration selection
sample: Three training-set respondents per country-treatment stratum, one deterministic task each; 21 people, 63 calls across three background conditions

admission_evidence.license_cloud_use: Zenodo record 10046247 CC BY 4.0; user authorizes necessary anonymous background at official endpoint. No contact, location coordinate, raw record or respondent identifier sent.
admission_evidence.question_mapping: dryer-reconciliation.json: 20216 original choices match; Table 2 and Figure 10 support text-rendered choices. Unresolved personalised-cost and USA generic-cost conditions excluded before model execution.
admission_evidence.background_timing: Weekly use precedes the personalised experimental display (paper equation 7). Age/education/household size treated as stable attributes existing at choice time, even if elicited later. This is a stated retrospective-measurement assumption, not proof of questionnaire ordering. Financial comfort excluded from this technical pilot pending timing review.
admission_evidence.author_statistics: All 12 published country-treatment counts and 120 Table 4 means reproduce; use final long table without joining wide table.
admission_evidence.leakage_review: Explicit payload construction sends question/options/context/whitelisted background only; answers, identifiers, task IDs, groups, weights and source metadata stay local. Test respondents are not selected. No scores produced.

limitations: Pilot is not a formal outcome experiment.
No evidence of predictive improvement can be inferred from format compliance.
Field richness and final experiment arms remain subject to frozen formal protocol.
